page.overview:
What is Isembard Took?

Isembard Took was one of the many uncles of Bilbo Baggins.

Isembard was the seventh child of Gerontius "The Old" Took and Adamanta (Chubb) Took. Isembard had six older siblings: Isengrim III, Hildigard, Isumbras IV, Hildigrim, Isembold, and Hildifons; and five younger siblings: Hildibrand, Belladonna, Donnamira, Mirabella, and Isengar. He had a son named Flambard, who was born in TA 2887 (SR 1287). Isembard died in TA 2946 (SR 1346).
